title: How Will Europe Pay for Ukraine? The EU Funding Fight | Global Meridian
description_html:
European Union leaders meet in Brussels to decide how Ukraine will be funded through 2027. We explain the funding gap, who is paying and who is not, why the money has been so hard to agree, what it means for budgets, taxes and prices, and what the next steps look like.

2:06 What should you do?
2:34 My Take
2:55 Outro

Sources
According to official reports and statements: European Council, European Commission and Ukrainian government statements, EU member-state governments, official budget figures.

This is an extract of our Daily Crux of 27 November 2026. Watch the full Daily Crux for the other stories and world headlines.
